conventions.result_set: b (only the uncertainties real for this pseudo-data: statistics, lepton scale and resolution, efficiency SFs, the Z+X method, the A x eff(m_H) morphing)
conventions.mu: sigma/sigma_SM at the measured m_H: sigma_eff(mode, m_H) from the YR4 table, A x eff(m_H) by rest-frame morphing of the 125 GeV MC
conventions.uncertainties: value from the profile likelihood; total and stat the symmetrized MINOS intervals (stat with the nuisances fixed at their best fit); syst the quadrature sum of the fixed-nuisance impacts
conventions.calibration: per flavour (user decision 2026-09-25): scale_shift (data/MC - 1 of the lepton momentum), smear (extra relative per-lepton pT width in quadrature) and sel_eff (tag-and-probe data/MC efficiency ratio of the full single-lepton selection), each the average over the data leptons of the Z -> ll calibration sample of the per-bin measurements of that flavour; working points: muon: AN loose muon (global or tracker, |dxy| < 0.5 cm, |dz| < 1 cm) + PF ID (tracker high-pT ID above 200 GeV) + SIP3D < 4 + FSR-subtracted relative isolation (dR 0.3) < 0.35; electron: AN loose electron (|dxy| < 0.5 cm, |dz| < 1 cm) + mvaFall17V2noIso WPL + SIP3D < 4 + FSR-subtracted relative isolation (dR 0.3) < 0.35
conventions.eff_correction: expected signal yield with the tag-and-probe SFs / without, per final state and inclusive
conventions.reconstruction_efficiency: taken from the MC (user decision 2026-09-25: not measurable with tag-and-probe with these inputs, the production preselection biases reconstruction probes); the SFs are the tag-and-probe chain id | loose, sip | id, iso | id and sip
conventions.trigger_efficiency: taken from the MC (user decision 2026-09-25; about 1 for four-lepton events in data and MC), the Z -> ll yield ratio covering it as a cross-check
conventions.paper_style_fits: per final state, category, mode, (mu_F, mu_V), STXS and mu at 125.09 GeV: the paper's Eq. 10.1, L(m4l, D_bkg^kin) with m4l without the Z1 refit, result set (a), POIs in [0, 20]

calibration_average.definition: average over the data leptons of the Z -> ll calibration sample (both legs of the data control pairs of the calibration extract passing the calibration leg selection, 60 < m_ll < 120 GeV after the data correction)

muon.definition: tag-and-probe SF of the full single-lepton selection (chain id | loose, sip | id, iso | id and sip) at pT = 45 GeV, |eta| = 1.2 (bilinear between bin centres)

electron.definition: tag-and-probe SF of the full single-lepton selection (chain id | loose, sip | id, iso | id and sip) at pT = 45 GeV, |eta| = 1.2 (bilinear between bin centres)

systematics_evidence.lepton_scale: scale_mu and scale_e nuisances (per flavour, from the in-situ Z calibration and its closures) move the signal peak
systematics_evidence.lepton_resolution: res_mu and res_e nuisances (per flavour) scale the signal width
systematics_evidence.lepton_efficiency: eff_mu and eff_e nuisances from the tag-and-probe SF uncertainties (statistical and fit model) on the signal, qqZZ and ggZZ yields
systematics_evidence.luminosity: set (a): 2.5 % on every MC yield (the benchmark set (b) has none: the pseudo-data luminosity is exact)
systematics_evidence.branching_ratio: set (a): 2 % on the signal (none in set (b))
systematics_evidence.reducible_bkg_Zjets: zx_<final state> log-normal nuisances from the data-driven OS/SS combination (statistics, MC-closure systematic, method envelope)
systematics_evidence.qqZZ_theory: set (a): 0.045 on qqZZ (QCD scale and PDF)
systematics_evidence.signal_PDF_acceptance: set (a): PDF + alpha_s per mode {'ggH': 0.032, 'VBF': 0.021, 'VH': 0.018}; the acceptance x efficiency m_H dependence through the morph nuisance
systematics_evidence.signal_shape: the DCB peak position and width per flavour (scale and resolution nuisances) and the m_H morphing (scale vs shift); the DCB tails fixed from the MC fit
systematics_evidence.background_shape: Z+X shape from the combined OS/SS fit (no shape nuisance), qqZZ/ggZZ m4l and D_bkg^kin shapes from the MC; no jet-energy variations (not available in the inputs)

notes.systematics_groups: describe the paper-style result set (a); RESULT.json uses set (b)

working_points.electron: AN loose electron (|dxy| < 0.5 cm, |dz| < 1 cm) + mvaFall17V2noIso WPL + SIP3D < 4 + FSR-subtracted relative isolation (dR 0.3) < 0.35

notes.nm1_method: counting in 118 < m4l < 130 GeV: S = ggH + VBF + VH MC, B = qqZZ + ggZZ MC + the data-driven Z+X of the same selection; no SFs; Z = sqrt(2 [(S + B) ln(1 + S/B) - S]); N-1 = one requirement relaxed to the event-record floor (user decisions 2026-09-25)

compatibility.comment: one common mu against three, both L(m4l, D_bkg^kin) at m_H = 125.09 GeV

ggH.comment: A_fid relative to the delivered sample's sigma_eff (LO Pythia8; the paper: POWHEG)

VBF.comment: A_fid relative to the delivered sample's sigma_eff (LO Pythia8; the paper: POWHEG)

VH.comment: A_fid relative to the delivered sample's sigma_eff (LO Pythia8; the paper: POWHEG)

final_state_compatibility.method: chi2 of r_fid per final state against their weighted mean

systematics.comment: Nuisance magnitudes of the likelihood (h4l_likelihood.py).  Set (b): lepton scale and resolution per flavour from the in-situ calibration (to be updated from the final calibration and its closure), efficiency from the tag-and-probe payload (per event), Z+X from the combined estimate, the A x eff(m_H) morphing (scale vs shift).  Set (a) adds the AN/paper theory and luminosity magnitudes: luminosity 2.5 %, BR 2 %, qqZZ theory (QCD scale 3.2 %, PDF 3.1 %, in quadrature 4.5 %), ggZZ 10 %, signal QCD scale and PDF per mode (YR4 13 TeV: ggH 5.4 % / 3.2 %, VBF 0.4 % / 2.1 %, VH 0.7 % / 1.8 %, symmetrized).  v2: the lepton scale and resolution magnitudes and the flavour fractions derived by make_systematics.py from the calibration, its closures and the signal MC (details block).  v3 (final review 2026-09-25): set (a) VH QCD scale 0.017, the sigma-weighted mean of the YR4 WH (+0.5/-0.7 %) and ZH (+3.8/-3.1 %) QCD-scale uncertainties (v2 had the WH value only); every set (b) item unchanged.

substitutions: no signal-background interference term (no interference sample)

z4l.method: DCB of the ZZ MC per final state, data fitted with a free mean; m_Z = 91.1876 + shift
